source_text: Spiritaliter arca ecclesia est; Noe Christus — requies et iustus. Pauci scientia rationabili in summitate cum Noe; multitudo irrationabilium in inferioribus. Per gradus ad Christum. Lamech: hic requiem dabit — perfecte in Christum, qui tollit peccatum mundi.
pass_a_gloss: Spiritually ark church is; Noah Christ — rest and just. Few with-knowledge rational on summit with Noah; crowd of-irrational on lower. Through steps to Christ. Lamech: this-one rest will-give — perfectly toward Christ, who takes-away sin of-world.
pass_b_english: Spiritually the ark is the church; Noah is Christ — rest and the just one. Few who live by rational knowledge stand at the summit with Noah; the crowd of the irrational holds the lower places. By steps one comes to Christ. Lamech said, [[This one will give us rest >> Bible:Genesis 5:29]] — fulfilled perfectly in Christ, [[who takes away the sin of the world >> Bible:John 1:29]].
